start.content: Forty days. That is how long He stayed with us after the empty tomb. Not every day, not in one place, but appearing — breaking bread on the road, cooking fish on the shore, teaching in the upper room. And now, on the Mount of Olives, He stops. Lifts His hands. Blesses us.

choices.text: What did the blessing feel like?
Did you know He was leaving?

blessing.content:
# UNLOCK_EVIDENCE: great_commission_mandate
It was not a theatrical performance. It was a priest's hands — the same hands that had been pierced, now lifted in favor over the eleven of us. The same voice that called Lazarus from the grave now spoke peace over our confusion. 'You will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you,' He said. 'And you will be my witnesses.'

leaving.content:
# UNLOCK_EVIDENCE: ascension_eyewitness_account
# UNLOCK_EVIDENCE: great_commission_mandate
He had said before, 'I go to prepare a place for you.' We thought it was a figure of speech. We did not expect the mechanics of it. As He blessed us, He began to rise. Not flying, not vanishing — being taken. A cloud received Him, and the sky swallowed Him up until we could no longer see.

witnesses.content: To the ends of the earth. That is what He said. Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria, and to the ends of the earth. We had hoped He would restore the kingdom to Israel. Instead, He gave us a commission that spans continents. The scope of it terrified me. But then I remembered — I had seen the empty tomb. I had touched the wounds. I had watched Him ascend. If He can do that, He can do this.

angels.content: Two men in white. They did not arrive with fanfare; they were simply there, standing beside us. 'Men of Galilee,' they said, 'why do you stand looking into heaven? This same Jesus, who was taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go.' It was the final piece. Not just a departure, but a promise.

closing.content: We returned to Jerusalem, just as He had commanded. The task is enormous. But the One who gave it is greater. He is coming back. We must be ready.
